north_star.title: Personal knowledge base
north_star.problem_statement: Notes are scattered across tools and hard to revisit.
north_star.desired_outcome: One place to capture and resurface ideas.
success_criteria: Can find a note from 6 months ago in under a minute
north_star.current_hypothesis: A local-first app with full-text search is enough.
north_star.next_action: Prototype a search index over existing notes.
